text: keep-reminder 是一个适用于 DSH 各类客户端的上下文插件：它在 agent 的 pre-step 阶段读取会话工作目录中的提醒文件，并把内容包装成 system-reminder 用户消息加入上下文。用户可以选择每个会话首次运行、每轮首次运行或每次请求时注入，也可以配置文件路径。文件缺失、为空或工作目录不可用时会静默跳过；内容每次触发时重新读取，适合存放需要持续带入模型对话的项目约定或个人提醒。使用时需在 DSH profile 中挂载插件，并在会话工作目录创建提醒文件；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

keep-reminder injects a workspace reminder file into DSH context as a system-reminder. Set it to run once per session, per turn, or per request, and optionally choose another file path. Missing or blank files are skipped. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 每轮开始时自动带上项目里的注意事项。
能不能把工作目录中的一段固定提醒放进模型上下文？
我希望每次发起模型请求时都重新读取本地说明文件。
让会话只在第一次运行时加载一次我的长期提示。
提醒文件暂时不存在时，希望插件能直接跳过而不打断对话。
如何给不同会话指定各自的本地上下文文件？
Can I automatically include a workspace note in the model context at the start of each turn?
I want a local reminder file reread for every model request.
keep-reminder 的功能「按模式注入提醒」：从会话工作目录读取配置文件，并将非空内容作为 system-reminder 消息加入对话。可设为每个会话一次、每轮一次或每次请求一次。
keep-reminder 的功能「自定义提醒文件」：配置 file 指定相对 agent 工作目录或绝对路径的文件，默认读取 .keep-reminder；在注入触发时读取当前内容。
keep-reminder 的功能「容错跳过空文件」：提醒文件不存在、内容只有空白，或会话没有工作目录时，不添加提醒消息并继续原有流程。

text:
keep-reminder README · What is the "session workspace root"?：It is the session's working directory (`cwd`); the plugin looks for `.keep-reminder` only there and does not search upward.

- **Web GUI**: the folder you pick when creating the session. If you pick `D:\ui-workspace\my-project`, put it at `D:\ui-workspace\my-project\.keep-reminder`.
- **CLI / headless**: the current directory where you run `dsh` (`process.cwd()`).

keep-reminder README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `turn` | Injection frequency: `session` / `turn` / `request` |
| `file` | `.keep-reminder` | File path; relative to the session working directory, or absolute |

keep-reminder README · Three modes：| mode | When injected |
|---|---|
| `session` | Once per session (first step of the first turn) |
| `turn` | Once per turn (first step) |
| `request` | Every model request |
keep-reminder README · Comparison：`AGENTS.md`, direct user prompts, and this plugin all convey information to the model, but with different purposes:

keep-reminder README · Comparison：| Dimension | AGENTS.md | User prompt | keep-reminder |
|---|---|---|---|
| Channel | `<system-reminder>` user message | ordinary user message | `<system-reminder>` user message |
| Scope | global (`~/.dsh`) + project directories | one message | one file in the workspace root |
| Frequency | once per session, updated on change | one-shot | `session`/`turn`/`request` |
| Priority | guidance (below system prompt and direct user instructions) | direct user instruction (highest) | guidance (same as AGENTS.md) |
| Maintenance | edit a file | write each time | edit a file |
| Live update | yes | — | yes (re-read per injection) |
| Use case | team / project conventions | temporary, one-off | personal "must-remember" reminders |

keep-reminder README · File-state handling：How the plugin treats the `.keep-reminder` file in each state:

| State | Behavior |
|---|---|
| File missing | Silently skipped — no injection, no error |
| File exists but empty/whitespace | Silently skipped — no injection |
| File has content | Injected as `<system-reminder>` per `mode` |
| Content modified | New content injected next turn/request (re-read live) |
| File deleted | Injection stops from the next turn, silently |
| File restored | Injection resumes |
